__dyl_g: Wendel "Bones" Dyl, a farmhand from Northwick, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in T-F19. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Wendel "Bones" Dyl came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Wendel "Bones" Dyl wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Wendel "Bones" Dyl's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at T-F19 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Wendel "Bones" Dyl watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Wendel "Bones" Dyl held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.

A bullet hit Wendel "Bones" Dyl's belt buckle at T-F19 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis of the Hegemony (@ihatethis1988).
The wound on Wendel "Bones" Dyl's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
The parcel for Wendel "Bones" Dyl contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Wendel "Bones" Dyl fired at a movement across the wire at T-F19. The man went down: Florian Kyrenhaong, grazed.

Wendel "Bones" Dyl fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Hugo Boi, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Wendel "Bones" Dyl saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at T-F19 and fired once. Isidor "Parson" Potvin was grazed.
Wendel fired at the enemy dawn watch from T-F19. Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
_champions: "You're late," said the corporal when Severin Champions arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Severin Champions shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Severin Champions took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Severin Champions helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Severin Champions and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Severin Champions fired. Quentin Archiegregor was badly wounded. Severin Champions saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Matthias "Tin" Wwjd, was badly wounded.
Severin Champions offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
A man asked Severin Champions to describe Stoneyford without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Severin Champions moved to a new hide at S-R13 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Casimir "Whistle" Bob, grazed.
Severin Champions began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Officers came to inspect S-R13. Severin Champions polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R13 and grazed Severin's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy).
allu91825: Felix "Lucky" Allu told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry. Orders came through: Felix "Lucky" Allu is a field cook now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pressed cornflower.

Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Felix "Lucky" Allu wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A letter from home reached Felix "Lucky" Allu before dusk. Felix "Lucky" Allu read it twice and slept a little easier.

On a quiet night Felix "Lucky" Allu (Concord) and Albin "Tin" Ringwraith (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home reached Felix "Lucky" Allu before dusk. Felix "Lucky" Allu read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-F22 with the rations. Felix "Lucky" Allu ate while listening to the revised orders.
Felix "Lucky" Allu saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
A loose thread in Felix "Lucky" Allu's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
Felix "Lucky" Allu taught Edmund Edhi to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
A bullet went through Felix "Lucky" Allu's sleeve at T-F22 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Jonas Viaenegilles of the Hegemony (@viaenegilles).
The medics cleaned Felix "Lucky" Allu's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at T-F22.
Felix "Lucky" Allu reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F22 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Albin Welcometomem of the Hegemony (@welcometomemetown2.0).
Felix came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
bascinetpuppy: The sergeant gave Matthias "Lucky" Bascinetpupp a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 11 or any other. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Matthias "Lucky" Bascinetpupp watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Matthias "Lucky" Bascinetpupp was hit through the chest at P-F17. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff of the Concord (@jadenmurff). Matthias "Lucky" Bascinetpupp was killed outright at P-F17, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Quentin "Brick" Jadenmurff of the Concord (@jadenmurff).
Valentin Bascinetpupp put a tin whistle beside the bunk. Someone who had known Matthias "Lucky" Bascinetpupp helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Quentin Andrew wrote a song about Calvary Farm. Valentin Bascinetpupp wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Valentin Bascinetpupp saw Roland Seallesak freeze up on the fire step at Grey Mill. Valentin said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Valentin Bascinetpupp (Hegemony) and Ulrich "Bones" Cocac (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Drowned Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Valentin Bascinetpupp closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Valentin Bascinetpupp found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Valentin held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
elliott_goyhenetche: Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche unpacked a lock of hair in a matchbox at R-C9. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche became a rifleman today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. A letter from home found Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche before the night shift. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche folded it small and kept it close.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. A letter from home found Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche before the night shift. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche is number 705 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-C9 and fired once. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy was grazed.
A supply man offered Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution. A letter from home found Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche before the night shift. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche fired back. Konrad Romania was badly wounded. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Karel Zzkaake, now badly wounded. A letter for Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche came with a photograph. Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche looked at it for a long time and said nothing.
The whole squad at R-C9 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche's bullet that found Cyril Jordancrowe, grazed.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-C9. Bastian fired at the last man to run. Wendel Hans was gravely wounded. A small parcel arrived for Bastian: a pencil and a pad of paper. The note said: write to us. Bastian began at once.
felixwallner: Ivo Felixwallner stepped off the supply cart at P-F14 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher wrote a song about Calvary Farm. Ivo Felixwallner wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Ivo Felixwallner watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Ivo Felixwallner changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. A letter from home found Ivo Felixwallner before the night shift. Ivo Felixwallner folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo Felixwallner had just lit a cigarette at P-F14 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Jonas Art of the Concord (@c_crash_trash_art). A letter from home found Ivo Felixwallner before the night shift. Ivo Felixwallner folded it small and kept it close.

Wiring party. Ivo Felixwallner held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at P-F14, and everyone came back. Fever took hold of Ivo Felixwallner overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. A letter from home found Ivo Felixwallner before the night shift. Ivo Felixwallner folded it small and kept it close.

The medics called Ivo Felixwallner 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Ivo Felixwallner is back on the line. A letter from home found Ivo Felixwallner before the night shift. Ivo Felixwallner folded it small and kept it close.

Listening post, three in the morning. Ivo Felixwallner heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. A letter came for Ivo Felixwallner with a ribbon tied around it. Ivo Felixwallner kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Ivo Felixwallner read a theatre review while peeling supper. The letter for Ivo Felixwallner had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Ivo Felixwallner dried it by the stove, page by page.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Ivo could not stop listening to it. A letter for Ivo came with a photograph of a very large cat. The squad passed it around and agreed that it looked well fed.
florida_man216: Karel Man came up with a draft of replacements on Day 5. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Karel Man taught Benedikt Rezasiibiil to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home reached Karel Man before dusk. Karel Man read it twice and slept a little easier.
Karel Man was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
The fog lifted at noon and Karel Man saw the Drowned Farm clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed.
Felix Crobus fell asleep on watch. Karel Man took over without waking Felix, and told the sergeant nothing.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Man watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Karel Man was hit through the stomach at R-S11. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Dietrich Zzz of the Hegemony (@bijan_zzz). Karel Man was hit at R-S11 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Dietrich Zzz of the Hegemony (@bijan_zzz).

Casimir Man put a photograph gone soft at the edges beside the bunk. Someone who had known Karel Man helped clear the shelf without saying why. Casimir Man got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 431. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Casimir Man helped stack spare sandbags at R-S11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Casimir Man of the Concord and Severin "Mud" Goat of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near the Brickworks all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Casimir Man fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Karel Freddie, badly wounded.
A supply man offered Casimir Man a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Casimir Man reached up to fix a sandbag at R-S11 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Matthias "Ash" Blasian of the Hegemony (@blasian117).

Casimir Man was hit in the foot through his boot at R-S11. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Silas Green of the Hegemony (@femboy_green). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Casimir Man fell at R-S11 and never moved again. Shot by Silas Green of the Hegemony (@femboy_green).
The House of Man sent another. Norbert "Whistle" Man, father of Casimir Man, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Norbert "Whistle" Man rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Norbert found a pair of dry socks and put them on. For a whole minute, nothing in the war mattered.
gdaydane: Hugo Gdaydane stepped off the supply cart at V-F17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name. After what happened at Lantern Hill, Hugo Gdaydane asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

Rafael Jacob (Hegemony) watched Hugo Gdaydane (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Saint-Ash crossroads, and held fire until both were gone. A letter from home found Hugo Gdaydane before the night shift. Hugo Gdaydane folded it small and kept it close.

Hugo Gdaydane kept Dorian Maxhuntertat awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Hugo could have walked there blind. A letter from home found Hugo Gdaydane before the night shift. Hugo Gdaydane folded it small and kept it close.
Hugo Gdaydane spent the afternoon chasing his cap across the trench. It stopped every time he did, and jumped away again when he reached for it.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Hugo Gdaydane was waiting. Albin Codibandz was gravely wounded.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At V-F17 they left Hugo Gdaydane behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Florian Grishagoblin of the Hegemony (@grishagoblin).
The papers say Dietrich Gdaydane. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Hugo Gdaydane's eyes. Nobody in V-F17 argues.
Dietrich Gdaydane (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Anselm "Ghost" Hofmann (Hegemony) at the Brickworks. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
A bullet skipped off a rock and cut Dietrich's ear at V-F17. He cursed, wrapped it in a sock, and stayed at the post. Shot by Quentin "Smokes" Chanley of the Hegemony (@chanley87).
gideon_j_a_nieuwenhuis_: Quentin Nieuwenhuis found a place in S-C7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Quentin Nieuwenhuis shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Quentin Nieuwenhuis waited for that to change. When it did, Ulrich Emmettofthek was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin Nieuwenhuis answered to number 726. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Quentin Nieuwenhuis could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Quentin Nieuwenhuis watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-C7 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Otto Raphoto was badly wounded.
Quentin Nieuwenhuis let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Zeno Raphoto was grazed.
Quentin Nieuwenhuis spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Quentin Nieuwenhuis wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Quentin Nieuwenhuis used it. Benedikt Jakubwilkuu was badly wounded.
A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at S-C7. Quentin Nieuwenhuis saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Benedikt Pablo was grazed.
Quentin Nieuwenhuis tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Asked what he will do after the war, Quentin said: 'Be a baker in Rosenau. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
ihatethis1988: Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis was a clockmaker in Tannenfeld until the posters went up. He came to T-F21 with a photograph gone soft at the edges, and within a day the whole squad knew that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.

Dawn watch. Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bastian Teamkaylin, badly wounded. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis. Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Wendel "Bones" Dyl did not get to reply at all, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis. Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis was hit through the stomach at T-F21. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis died waiting. The men at T-F21 have not stopped talking about it.
Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis joined T-F21 under the shadow of Dorian "Lucky" Ihatethis's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Arno Teamkaylin came out for a cup and was grazed. Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F21. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Zeno Thebaconnati of the Concord (@thebaconnation). Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis. Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medic cut the last bandage off Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to T-F21 the same hour. A letter reached Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Leopold "Saint" Ihatethis waited for that to change. When it did, Ulrich Yeti was gravely wounded.

Leopold had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Wendel Liamlove, grazed. A bullet hit Leopold in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at T-F21. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Wendel "Bones" Dyl of the Concord (@__dyl_g).
joshua_b314: Leopold Joshua, a baker from Dunmarrow, was sent forward on Day 17 to fill a gap in M-F12. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Leopold was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at M-F12. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Walter Taylormanme of the Concord (@taylormanme). Leopold got a letter in a child's handwriting. Every sentence started with 'Please' and ended with 'Come back.' Leopold had to go and stand outside for a minute.
justmusl: They issued Benedikt Justmusl a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a photograph gone soft at the edges in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem fell asleep on watch. Benedikt Justmusl took over without waking Button, and told the sergeant nothing. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Benedikt Justmusl shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Benedikt Justmusl traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

A bullet hit Benedikt Justmusl's belt buckle at U-F13 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Ulrich "Bones" Kangaroo of the Concord (@kangaroo.5791274).

Benedikt Justmusl took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at U-F13, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Leopold "Mud" Peterpederpe of the Concord (@peterpederpeter).
Benedikt Justmusl spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
There was never a bed for Benedikt Justmusl, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to U-F13 on his own feet.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Benedikt Justmusl pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
A parcel came for Benedikt that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: three pairs of woollen mittens. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
martin.el12: On Day 9 Dorian "Ash" Martin took a post at Q-F11 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He knows every star by name, and the men liked him for it.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian "Ash" Martin heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home reached Dorian "Ash" Martin before dusk. Dorian "Ash" Martin read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Ash" Martin lent Emil Sup a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg. A letter from home reached Dorian "Ash" Martin before dusk. Dorian "Ash" Martin read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F11 with the rations. Dorian "Ash" Martin ate while listening to the revised orders.

Dorian "Ash" Martin saved the last of the sugar for Felix "Mole" Ngles's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Mole's birthday. It was a good day anyway. A letter from home reached Dorian "Ash" Martin before dusk. Dorian "Ash" Martin read it twice and slept a little easier.
Dorian "Ash" Martin tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

The patrol came back one man at a time. Dorian "Ash" Martin held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. A letter from home reached Dorian "Ash" Martin before dusk. Dorian "Ash" Martin read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Ash" Martin drew a map of Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact's hometown from Owl's stories. Owl says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home reached Dorian "Ash" Martin before dusk. Dorian "Ash" Martin read it twice and slept a little easier.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at Q-F11. Dorian "Ash" Martin was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Ivo Kieran of the Hegemony (@kim_jong_un_kieran).
The papers connected Bastian Martin to Dorian "Ash" Martin. The men took longer to learn Bastian Martin's own habits, but they made the effort.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Bastian Martin helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
Bastian fell asleep behind the gun. The loader covered him with a blanket and took the watch.
ryann.lg: Roland Ryann found a place in T-F15 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Ryann watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Otto Fin (Hegemony) and Roland Ryann (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at Hill 304 for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Roland Ryann kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Roland Ryann came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.
A round went through Roland Ryann's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Roland Gethectoredb of the Hegemony (@gethectoredbruh).
Roland Ryann is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Roland Ryann worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Roland Ryann found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Roland Ryann spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Roland replaced a torn sandbag at T-F15 with a new one. A small job. The squad noticed and said nothing, which is a thank you.
sammmmyv523: Emil Sammmmyv came up on Day 10 carrying news from Northwick. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Emil Sammmmyv was hit in the forearm at P-F13. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Teodor Serdr of the Concord (@serdr.tg). Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Emil Sammmmyv shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Back on the fire step at P-F13. Emil Sammmmyv says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Emil Sammmmyv and Roland Jester made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Emil Sammmmyv checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Emil Sammmmyv's ear at P-F13 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Teodor Timmy of the Concord (@timmy7jc).
Emil Sammmmyv returned to P-F13 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Emil Sammmmyv (Hegemony) and Oskar Adams (Concord) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at Verdel Ridge on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
Silas Ewalters (Concord) and Emil (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at the Brickworks for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
squidward80328: By the time Emil Squidward reached W-F14, the war was 15 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Emil Squidward measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong. The letter for Emil Squidward had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Emil Squidward dried it by the stove, page by page.
Emil Squidward lent Edmund Duro a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Emil checked the wire at W-F14 on his hands and knees. It was whole. He returned before dawn with mud on his chin.
xsabrexx: Walter Xsabrexx walked into W-F11 on Day 18 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
zxburg4827: In Northwick, Leopold Zxburg was a blacksmith. In T-F23, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a blacksmith again.

The men at T-F23 heard Leopold Zxburg call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Oskar "Bones" Theophane of the Concord (@theophane_br). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Leopold Zxburg fell at T-F23 and never moved again. Shot by Oskar "Bones" Theophane of the Concord (@theophane_br).

The papers connected Henrik Zxburg to Leopold Zxburg. The men took longer to learn Henrik Zxburg's own habits, but they made the effort. Victory at Grey Mill. Henrik Zxburg let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix (Concord) and Henrik Zxburg (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Hanging Bridge. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
Henrik Zxburg was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row.

Henrik Zxburg was hit in the hip at T-F23. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Arno "Rabbit" Snake of the Concord (@__snake__cx). Henrik Zxburg was killed outright at T-F23, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Arno "Rabbit" Snake of the Concord (@__snake__cx).
Another member of the House of Zxburg reached the line: Anselm "Rabbit" Zxburg. He asked where Henrik Zxburg had slept, then chose a different corner.
A grenade burst short of the parapet at T-F23. Anselm "Rabbit" Zxburg took a splinter in the hand and was bandaged where he stood.

A bullet struck Anselm "Rabbit" Zxburg below the ribs at T-F23. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Florian Can of the Concord (@vin.can.do). Anselm "Rabbit" Zxburg looked over the parapet at T-F23 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Florian Can of the Concord (@vin.can.do).
A letter came with Cyril "Saint" Zxburg: "I am Anselm "Rabbit" Zxburg's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Cyril "Saint" Zxburg (Hegemony) and Viktor "Button" Chasserant (Concord) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Bone Quarry on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
Cyril and Silas Viaenegilles made a pact: whoever got leave first would visit the other's mother. They shook on it.
